name: gizza-ai/rent-vs-buy
summary: Compare the long-run financial outcome of renting versus buying a home, with a break-even year and net-worth verdict.

tool.description: Compare the long-run financial outcome of renting versus buying a home using the standard invest-the-difference net-worth race, not a naive monthly rent-vs-mortgage comparison. Pass home_price, down_payment_percent, mortgage_rate_percent and loan_term_years for the purchase; monthly_rent for the alternative; and years for how long you'll stay (the biggest driver). Tune home_appreciation_percent, rent_growth_percent, investment_return_percent (higher returns favour renting), property_tax_percent, home_insurance_percent, maintenance_percent, hoa_monthly, buying_closing_percent and selling_cost_percent. The buyer's up-front cash is invested by the renter as opportunity cost; each month whoever pays less invests the difference; both funds compound. Every parameter is optional with a sensible default. Returns loan_amount, down_payment, total_upfront_cost, monthly_principal_interest, first_month_buy_cost, first_month_rent_cost, buy_net_worth, rent_net_worth, net_worth_difference, verdict (buy|rent|even), break_even_year, home_value_at_horizon, remaining_mortgage_at_horizon, total_rent_paid, a year-by-year net-worth race, and a plain-language summary.

buying_closing_percent.description: Buying closing costs as a percent of the price, paid up front. Default 3.

currency.description: Currency symbol prefixed to amounts in the summary. Default $.

decimals.description: Decimal places for money outputs. Default 0 (range 0–10).

down_payment_percent.description: Down payment as a percent of the price. Default 20.

hoa_monthly.description: Monthly HOA / condo dues, in your currency. Default 0.

home_insurance_percent.description: Annual home insurance as a percent of home value. Default 0.5.

home_price.description: Home purchase price, in your currency. Default 400000.

investment_return_percent.description: Annual after-tax return the renter earns on the invested down payment and monthly savings (percent). Higher returns favour renting. Default 5.

maintenance_percent.description: Annual maintenance/repairs as a percent of home value. Default 1.

monthly_rent.description: Current monthly rent for a comparable place. Default 2000.

mortgage_rate_percent.description: Nominal annual mortgage interest rate (percent). Default 6.5.

property_tax_percent.description: Annual property tax as a percent of home value. Default 1.1.

selling_cost_percent.description: Selling costs (agent commission + closing) as a percent of the eventual sale price. Default 6.

years.description: How many years you plan to stay — the comparison horizon. This is the single biggest driver of the result. Default 10.
